entries.name: Dominion OS 1.0 Enterprise Demo — Windows x64
entries.requirements: Self-contained Windows x64 package; synthetic-only enterprise demo; no separate .NET Desktop Runtime prerequisite
entries.description: Enterprise-acceptance-tested, distribution-hardened Dominion OS 1.0 demonstration covering Business Suite and Politics & Civic synthetic scenarios. CI and distribution-readiness are green on the exact build. Real AT2 first-install/visible-GUI lifecycle acceptance is proven for this exact build by immutable machine run 33361368179. Broad Authenticode-signed enterprise distribution remains separately unproven.

entries.name: Dominion OS 1.0 — Google Cloud Deployment Family
entries.requirements: Client-controlled Google Cloud environment; provider identity, IAM, runtime, cost, security and release evidence scoped per deployment
entries.description: Google Cloud source and deployment path with fail-closed public claims. Source/deployment readiness does not certify a currently live public provider runtime.
